solutionSql:
SELECT route_id, id, delivery_due
FROM (
  SELECT route_id, id, delivery_due,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY route_id ORDER BY delivery_due, id) AS rn
  FROM shipments
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY route_id, delivery_due, id;

ambiguities.phrase: return the two shipments due soonest
ambiguities.readingChosen: All shipments on the route, whatever their status, including delivered and cancelled ones.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Only open shipments (queued or in_transit). On the sample this changes routes 3, 5 and 6 (3 of 12 rows).

notes: ROW_NUMBER with (delivery_due, id) ordering. The ticket does not say whether closed shipments count, and that choice changes sample rows.
